page.overview:
Who is Ela Sutan?

Ela Sutan was a Caamasi female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. she Sometime later, Sutan was present in the Jedi Council Chamber when the Council received a message of help from the Scalvi.

Around 382 BBY, the Jedi was present when Porter Engle informed the Council that Barash Silvain took a vow to distance herself from the Jedi Order to find out what the Force wanted her to do.

Master Sutan would take part in the infamous Massacre on Dalna, after she and fellow high council member Gluth Andoi felt that the Force was calling them to Dalna personally. They decided to go with a contingent of Jedi including master Rinn and knight Azlin Rell. Taking a large ship adorned with the Jedi symbol they landed in the Dalnan city Ferdan, thus inadvertently disturbing ongoing negotiations between Jedi Oliviah Zeveron and Matthea Cathley with former Path of the Open Hand leader Werth Plouth and Yana Ro, the two Path members subsequently fleeing. The two Jedi greeted the council members before Ferdan Sheriff Jinx Pickwick angrily approached the ship and urged all the Jedi to leave. After everyone finished introducing themselves, the Council members invited everyone aboard their ship to discuss what had been happening. After they assuaged Pickwick's concerns and all explained why they were there, Zeveron and Cathley notably recognizing the dead Jedi from Rell's story as the ones they had previously had mentioned to them by Path member Xander Cran, they all decided to head into the Path compound peacefully and diplomatically in the hopes of reaching an understanding.

Master Ela Sutan and her group wandered through the surface of the Path compound, discovering it to be empty and sensing no one with the Force. Sutan yelled to announce who they were and what they wanted, but Path members, who were watching them via cameras, were ordered by the Mother, leader of the Path, to activate the trap waiting for the Jedi in the compound: enforcer droids. Though the droids emerged from the ground all around them and surrounded them, the Jedi pressed on, making their way forward to enter the caves. Seeing this, Path member Marda Ro decided to send the Great Leveler and its brethren out into the caves to hunt the Jedi.
